notes.title: Swing around with a water gun while cleaning high-rise buildings in Aerial Cleaner
notes.notes:
If you like your simpler games that have a fun unique idea then check out Aerial Cleaner, a 2D game about swinging around while cleaning high-rise buildings.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/09/swing-around-with-a-water-gun-while-cleaning-high-rise-buildings-in-aerial-cleaner
